notes: Source file hashes describe the originals before the publication README introduction and ignore additions.

english_edition.current_hash_fields: english_published_sha256 and english_published_size_bytes describe the English-edition files.
english_edition.scope: Translation and operational package integrity updates; no new circuit or school qualification.
